allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge: slow, a few centimetres a year; about 1 m at 20 years, 2.5 to 3 m at 50, 4 to 5 m at 90. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: bluish green leaves, grey-brown dead leaves on the branches, creamy flower clusters. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): six greenish-white tepals in two whorls, six stamens and a superior pistil of three carpels, from the characters of Asparagaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.carpels.note: How PlantGen draws a flower, a choice of the model's (spec rework P5): the flower characters set a flower card's perianth, its parts, how they differ by place, how far the corolla is joined into a tube, a floral cup, where the ovary sits, a resupinate flower's turn, its stamens, staminodes and carpels and its spurs. The rules also set these fields in a season's flower and bud looks that draw a flower, unless set there by hand.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tree 3 to 12 m tall whose trunk and branches carry dense rosettes of stiff, dagger-like, finely toothed leaves 15 to 35 cm long; a branch tip that flowers, or is damaged, stops and two or three branches grow from below it, so old trees branch every 0.6 to 0.9 m of growth (FEIS); dead leaves cling to the branches as a shaggy skirt; flowering is irregular, in good years only. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.program.note: The rosette succulents' program in this family (agaves, yuccas, sotols; growth plan G2.3a), on the rosette base: it gives the values the rosette program gave as defaults until then.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (milestone F2). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
